files.title: File:The Town Crier, v.24, no.50, Dec. 14, 1929 - DPLA - 07b7899b359fbddb2227a4b2be4a44fc (page 8).jpg

ObjectName.value: The Town Crier, v.24, no.50, Dec. 14, 1929

Categories.value: Media contributed by the Digital Public Library of America|Artworks without Wikidata item|Media contributed by Northwest Digital Heritage|Media contributed by Seattle Public Library|No known copyright|The Town Crier, 1929

ImageDescription.value: Annual Christmas number. Page 1 article notes the passing of Mrs. Cannie Trimble. Page 3 article discusses a gift from the Japanese of cherry blossom trees to be planted at Seward Park. Page 6 article discusses the career of theater entrepreneur Alexander Pantages. Pages 9-16 includes photographs of Japan. Pages 17-24 feature photographs taken by Wayne Albee. Page 28-30 article on Seattle rock gardens feature photographs taken by Frank Kunishige. Page 31 article discusses the artwork of Julius Ullman. Page 35-37 article discusses aviation in Seattle. Photographs of the Bryn Mawr airfield, an early seaplane, Thomas D. Stimson, Donald G. Graham, a Boeing passenger plane the Renton Airport are included. An advertisement for the Northwest Air Service appears on page 36. Page 38-41 article discusses notable buildings in Seattle with photographs taken by Frank Kunishige. Buildings featured include the Rainier Club, the Northern Life Tower, the Bon Marche, the Lakecrest Apartments, the Exeter Apartment Hotel, the 1411 Fourth Avenue Building, the Fox Theatre, the Kappa Alpha Theta Sorority house and the Phi Gamma Delta house at the University of Washington. Page 42-43 article highlights local Boy and Girl Scout activities with photographs taken at Camp Sealth and other locations. Page 50 includes drawings by Ernest Norling and a wood cut by William J.C. Klamm. Page 51-52 article by Viola Patterson discusses her travels in Europe with her husband Ambrose Patterson. Page 53 article discusses the start of the Seattle Reparatory Theatre with portraits of its founders Burton W. James and Florence James created by Mark Tobey. Page 54 highlights the sculptures of Jose de Creeft. Page 56 includes article on the Rhododendron Apartments with an interior photograph. Page 68 discusses the Nipon Yusen Kaisha Company. Photographs of the Siberia Maru and the NYK's Seattle office interior are included. ages 76-79 discuss theatre and dance productions by the Cornish School.

ImageDescription.value: Annual Christmas number. Page 1 article notes the passing of Mrs. Cannie Trimble. Page 3 article discusses a gift from the Japanese of cherry blossom trees to be planted at Seward Park. Page 6 article discusses the career of theater entrepreneur Alexander Pantages. Pages 9-16 includes photographs of Japan. Pages 17-24 feature photographs taken by Wayne Albee. Page 28-30 article on Seattle rock gardens feature photographs taken by Frank Kunishige. Page 31 article discusses the artwork of Julius Ullman. Page 35-37 article discusses aviation in Seattle. Photographs of the Bryn Mawr airfield, an early seaplane, Thomas D. Stimson, Donald G. Graham, a Boeing passenger plane the Renton Airport are included. An advertisement for the Northwest Air Service appears on page 36. Page 38-41 article discusses notable buildings in Seattle with photographs taken by Frank Kunishige. Buildings featured include the Rainier Club, the Northern Life Tower, the Bon Marche, the Lakecrest Apartments, the Exeter Apartment Hotel, the 1411 Fourth Avenue Building, the Fox Theatre, the Kappa Alpha Theta Sorority house and the Phi Gamma Delta house at the University of Washington. Page 42-43 article highlights local Boy and Girl Scout activities with photographs taken at Camp Sealth and other locations. Page 50 includes drawings by Ernest Norling and a wood cut by William J.C. Klamm. Page 51-52 article by Viola Patterson discusses her travels in Europe with her husband Ambrose Patterson. Page 53 article discusses the start of the Seattle Reparatory Theatre with portraits of its founders Burton W. James and Florence James created by Mark Tobey. Page 54 highlights the sculptures of Jose de Creeft. Page 56 includes article on the Rhododendron Apartments with an interior photograph. Page 68 discusses the Nipon Yusen Kaisha Company. Photographs of the Siberia Maru and the NYK's Seattle office interior are included. ages 76-79 discuss theatre and dance productions by the Cornish School.
